name: GMP controlled-rate cryopreservation of a gene-modified CD34+ HSC drug product (Kryo 560-16 three-ramp program: 4 C hold, -1/-2/-20 C/min to -180 C) before vapour-phase LN2 storage
plain_name: Freeze a gene-therapy stem-cell bag with a programmed three-step cooling recipe
description: Clinical-grade freezing of a lentivirally corrected hematopoietic stem cell product (MPSII gene therapy) in cryobags: the controlled-rate freezer holds 4 C, cools at -1 C/min to -30 C, -2 C/min to -60 C and -20 C/min to -180 C; the product then goes to vapour-phase liquid nitrogen at -130 C or colder.
keywords: Freeze a gene-therapy stem-cell bag with a programmed three-step cooling recipe

sources.citation: Design and validation of a GMP stem cell manufacturing protocol for MPSII hematopoietic stem cell gene therapy (Ellison et al., Mol Ther Methods Clin Dev 2024). DOI 10.1016/j.omtm.2024.101271

requirements.rationale: The freezing program starts with a 4 C hold and ends with a hold at -180 C, so the chamber must cover -180 C to +4 C.
The program imposes controlled cooling-rate magnitudes of 1, 2 and 20 C/min, so the freezer must control rates from 1 to 20 C/min.
Lowest program temperature is -180 C (same information as temperature.range, for machines that only document a base temperature).
Subsequent storage is in vapour-phase LN2 at -130 C or colder (a separate storage step; informative for the freezing machine).

confirmation_note: Requirements taken from the cited procedure and independently re-verified against the source (research/v4, 2026-11-01). Users must confirm them for their own run; edits require confirmation again.
